'''Laksh'atz''' was a senior [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] enrolled in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Laksh'atz was selected by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]], Laksh'atz joined fellow Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as part of Green Team in a competition arranged by Master [[Taria Damsin]]. The competition, taking place in the new [[Sublevel nineteen training dojo|Sublevel Nineteen Training Dojo]], ended in a tie. Laksh'atz was the first to fall in the competition after falling in the quake-ground field. Greatly disappointed, Laksh'atz quickly exited the dojo to wait for the competition to end.
